$comment: Pythagorean (Western) readings. Draft text by Claude, for numerologist review.

blocks.pythagorean.life_path.1: Life path 1: the pioneer. The journey is about independence, originality and learning to lead.
blocks.pythagorean.life_path.2: Life path 2: the peacemaker. The journey is about cooperation, sensitivity and partnership.
blocks.pythagorean.life_path.3: Life path 3: the communicator. The journey is about creativity, expression and joy.
blocks.pythagorean.life_path.4: Life path 4: the builder. The journey is about order, effort and lasting foundations.
blocks.pythagorean.life_path.5: Life path 5: the free spirit. The journey is about change, adventure and learning through experience.
blocks.pythagorean.life_path.6: Life path 6: the nurturer. The journey is about love, responsibility and service to family and community.
blocks.pythagorean.life_path.7: Life path 7: the seeker. The journey is about knowledge, reflection and inner truth.
blocks.pythagorean.life_path.8: Life path 8: the achiever. The journey is about power, judgement and material mastery used fairly.
blocks.pythagorean.life_path.9: Life path 9: the humanitarian. The journey is about compassion, completion and giving to the world.
blocks.pythagorean.life_path.11: Life path 11/2: the inspirer. A master path of intuition and vision, asking for faith in one's sensitivity.
blocks.pythagorean.life_path.22: Life path 22/4: the master builder. A path of turning great visions into real structures that serve many.
blocks.pythagorean.life_path.33: Life path 33/6: the master teacher. A rare path of healing, compassion and selfless guidance.
blocks.pythagorean.expression.1: Expression 1: talents for leading, deciding and creating something new.
blocks.pythagorean.expression.2: Expression 2: talents for diplomacy, support and fine detail.
blocks.pythagorean.expression.3: Expression 3: talents for words, art, humour and inspiring others.
blocks.pythagorean.expression.4: Expression 4: talents for planning, organising and steady craftsmanship.
blocks.pythagorean.expression.5: Expression 5: talents for communication, selling, travel and adapting fast.
blocks.pythagorean.expression.6: Expression 6: talents for care, teaching, design and creating harmony.
blocks.pythagorean.expression.7: Expression 7: talents for analysis, research and specialist knowledge.
blocks.pythagorean.expression.8: Expression 8: talents for management, finance and handling authority.
blocks.pythagorean.expression.9: Expression 9: talents for compassion, art and work on a large scale.
blocks.pythagorean.expression.11: Expression 11/2: talents for inspiration, intuition and uplifting others.
blocks.pythagorean.expression.22: Expression 22/4: talents for building large, practical enterprises.
blocks.pythagorean.expression.33: Expression 33/6: talents for healing, teaching and devoted service.
blocks.pythagorean.soul_urge.1: Soul urge 1: the heart wants independence and to be first at something.
blocks.pythagorean.soul_urge.2: Soul urge 2: the heart wants love, peace and close partnership.
blocks.pythagorean.soul_urge.3: Soul urge 3: the heart wants joy, expression and friends.
blocks.pythagorean.soul_urge.4: Soul urge 4: the heart wants security, order and a stable home.
blocks.pythagorean.soul_urge.5: Soul urge 5: the heart wants freedom, variety and adventure.
blocks.pythagorean.soul_urge.6: Soul urge 6: the heart wants family, beauty and to be needed.
blocks.pythagorean.soul_urge.7: Soul urge 7: the heart wants understanding, solitude and truth.
blocks.pythagorean.soul_urge.8: Soul urge 8: the heart wants achievement, respect and control of one's life.
blocks.pythagorean.soul_urge.9: Soul urge 9: the heart wants to help, to give and to make a difference.
blocks.pythagorean.soul_urge.11: Soul urge 11/2: the heart wants spiritual meaning and to inspire.
blocks.pythagorean.soul_urge.22: Soul urge 22/4: the heart wants to build something lasting for many.
blocks.pythagorean.soul_urge.33: Soul urge 33/6: the heart wants to heal and to serve with love.
blocks.pythagorean.personality.1: Personality 1: others see confidence, drive and independence.
blocks.pythagorean.personality.2: Personality 2: others see kindness, gentleness and tact.
blocks.pythagorean.personality.3: Personality 3: others see charm, humour and warmth.
blocks.pythagorean.personality.4: Personality 4: others see reliability, discipline and good sense.
blocks.pythagorean.personality.5: Personality 5: others see energy, wit and a love of fun.
blocks.pythagorean.personality.6: Personality 6: others see care, responsibility and good taste.
blocks.pythagorean.personality.7: Personality 7: others see reserve, intelligence and mystery.
blocks.pythagorean.personality.8: Personality 8: others see authority, competence and ambition.
blocks.pythagorean.personality.9: Personality 9: others see generosity, idealism and presence.
blocks.pythagorean.personality.11: Personality 11/2: others see sensitivity and an inspiring presence.
blocks.pythagorean.personality.22: Personality 22/4: others see a capable, trustworthy builder.
blocks.pythagorean.personality.33: Personality 33/6: others see a warm, caring guide.
blocks.pythagorean.maturity.1: Maturity 1: after about forty, life turns toward independence and leading one's own way.
blocks.pythagorean.maturity.2: Maturity 2: later life turns toward partnership, peace and quiet influence.
blocks.pythagorean.maturity.3: Maturity 3: later life turns toward creativity, joy and sharing ideas.
blocks.pythagorean.maturity.4: Maturity 4: later life turns toward stability, order and lasting work.
blocks.pythagorean.maturity.5: Maturity 5: later life turns toward freedom, travel and new experiences.
blocks.pythagorean.maturity.6: Maturity 6: later life turns toward family, community and care.
blocks.pythagorean.maturity.7: Maturity 7: later life turns toward study, reflection and inner peace.
blocks.pythagorean.maturity.8: Maturity 8: later life turns toward authority, results and recognition.
blocks.pythagorean.maturity.9: Maturity 9: later life turns toward service, wisdom and generosity.
blocks.pythagorean.maturity.11: Maturity 11/2: later life opens intuition and a calling to inspire.
blocks.pythagorean.maturity.22: Maturity 22/4: later life brings the chance to build something large and lasting.
blocks.pythagorean.maturity.33: Maturity 33/6: later life brings a role as healer or teacher.
blocks.pythagorean.balance.1: Balance 1: in hard times, stand firm and rely on your own judgement.
blocks.pythagorean.balance.2: Balance 2: in hard times, seek calm, talk it through and look for compromise.
blocks.pythagorean.balance.3: Balance 3: in hard times, lighten the mood and express what you feel.
blocks.pythagorean.balance.4: Balance 4: in hard times, make a plan and take practical steps.
blocks.pythagorean.balance.5: Balance 5: in hard times, stay flexible and change course if needed.
blocks.pythagorean.balance.6: Balance 6: in hard times, lean on family and take responsibility kindly.
blocks.pythagorean.balance.7: Balance 7: in hard times, step back, reflect and seek the deeper cause.
blocks.pythagorean.balance.8: Balance 8: in hard times, take charge calmly and use your authority fairly.
blocks.pythagorean.balance.9: Balance 9: in hard times, look at the bigger picture and forgive.
blocks.pythagorean.balance.11: Balance 11/2: in hard times, trust your intuition and quiet your nerves.
blocks.pythagorean.balance.22: Balance 22/4: in hard times, build a structure and work it patiently.
blocks.pythagorean.balance.33: Balance 33/6: in hard times, serve others and the way forward appears.
blocks.pythagorean.rational_thought.1: Rational thought 1: thinks independently and decides quickly.
blocks.pythagorean.rational_thought.2: Rational thought 2: weighs feelings and others' views before deciding.
blocks.pythagorean.rational_thought.3: Rational thought 3: thinks creatively and talks ideas through.
blocks.pythagorean.rational_thought.4: Rational thought 4: thinks step by step and trusts facts.
blocks.pythagorean.rational_thought.5: Rational thought 5: thinks fast and keeps several options open.
blocks.pythagorean.rational_thought.6: Rational thought 6: thinks of the effect on loved ones first.
blocks.pythagorean.rational_thought.7: Rational thought 7: thinks deeply and analyses before acting.
blocks.pythagorean.rational_thought.8: Rational thought 8: thinks strategically and in the long term.
blocks.pythagorean.rational_thought.9: Rational thought 9: thinks broadly and with compassion.
blocks.pythagorean.rational_thought.11: Rational thought 11/2: thinks intuitively, guided by inner knowing.
blocks.pythagorean.rational_thought.22: Rational thought 22/4: thinks in large, practical plans.
blocks.pythagorean.rational_thought.33: Rational thought 33/6: thinks of what will help the most people.
blocks.pythagorean.hidden_passion.1: Hidden passion 1: a strong drive to lead and to prove oneself.
blocks.pythagorean.hidden_passion.2: Hidden passion 2: a deep wish for closeness and harmony.
blocks.pythagorean.hidden_passion.3: Hidden passion 3: a love of expression, art and words.
blocks.pythagorean.hidden_passion.4: Hidden passion 4: a love of order, work and building.
blocks.pythagorean.hidden_passion.5: Hidden passion 5: a love of freedom, travel and new things.
blocks.pythagorean.hidden_passion.6: Hidden passion 6: a love of home, family and beauty.
blocks.pythagorean.hidden_passion.7: Hidden passion 7: a love of knowledge and the mysteries of life.
blocks.pythagorean.hidden_passion.8: Hidden passion 8: a drive for achievement and influence.
blocks.pythagorean.hidden_passion.9: Hidden passion 9: a passion for helping and for great causes.
blocks.pythagorean.karmic_lesson.1: Karmic lesson 1: learning self-belief and standing up for oneself.
blocks.pythagorean.karmic_lesson.2: Karmic lesson 2: learning patience, tact and cooperation.
blocks.pythagorean.karmic_lesson.3: Karmic lesson 3: learning to express feelings and ideas openly.
blocks.pythagorean.karmic_lesson.4: Karmic lesson 4: learning order, discipline and steady effort.
blocks.pythagorean.karmic_lesson.5: Karmic lesson 5: learning to welcome change and new experiences.
blocks.pythagorean.karmic_lesson.6: Karmic lesson 6: learning responsibility in home and relationships.
blocks.pythagorean.karmic_lesson.7: Karmic lesson 7: learning to trust, reflect and look deeper.
blocks.pythagorean.karmic_lesson.8: Karmic lesson 8: learning to manage money and authority well.
blocks.pythagorean.karmic_lesson.9: Karmic lesson 9: learning compassion and a wider view.
blocks.pythagorean.subconscious.0: Subconscious self 0: no number is present in the name, so the reading is not given.
blocks.pythagorean.subconscious.1: Subconscious self 1: unexpected events can unsettle; building inner security is the work.
blocks.pythagorean.subconscious.2: Subconscious self 2: emergencies feel heavy; support from others makes a big difference.
blocks.pythagorean.subconscious.3: Subconscious self 3: crises can scatter energy; focusing on one step at a time helps.
blocks.pythagorean.subconscious.4: Subconscious self 4: under pressure, practical effort helps, though worry can creep in.
blocks.pythagorean.subconscious.5: Subconscious self 5: reasonably steady in a crisis, with room to grow in calm.
blocks.pythagorean.subconscious.6: Subconscious self 6: responsible in a crisis, thinking first of others.
blocks.pythagorean.subconscious.7: Subconscious self 7: thoughtful in a crisis, analysing before acting.
blocks.pythagorean.subconscious.8: Subconscious self 8: confident and capable when things go wrong.
blocks.pythagorean.subconscious.9: Subconscious self 9: calm and resourceful in any emergency.

blocks.pythagorean.first_vowel.A: First vowel A: responds to life with initiative and directness.
blocks.pythagorean.first_vowel.E: First vowel E: responds to life with curiosity and enthusiasm.
blocks.pythagorean.first_vowel.I: First vowel I: responds to life with feeling and compassion.
blocks.pythagorean.first_vowel.O: First vowel O: responds to life with responsibility and principle.
blocks.pythagorean.first_vowel.U: First vowel U: responds to life with openness, sometimes hesitation.

blocks.pythagorean.plane.physical.low: Physical plane low: practical, hands-on matters take conscious effort.
blocks.pythagorean.plane.physical.balanced: Physical plane balanced: a healthy sense of the practical and the body.
blocks.pythagorean.plane.physical.strong: Physical plane strong: very practical, grounded and action-oriented.
blocks.pythagorean.plane.mental.low: Mental plane low: logic and analysis are less used than instinct or feeling.
blocks.pythagorean.plane.mental.balanced: Mental plane balanced: clear, sound thinking without overthinking.
blocks.pythagorean.plane.mental.strong: Mental plane strong: a sharp, analytical mind that loves ideas.
blocks.pythagorean.plane.emotional.low: Emotional plane low: feelings are kept private and expressed with effort.
blocks.pythagorean.plane.emotional.balanced: Emotional plane balanced: feelings are expressed naturally and well.
blocks.pythagorean.plane.emotional.strong: Emotional plane strong: deep, expressive feelings and creativity.
blocks.pythagorean.plane.intuitive.low: Intuitive plane low: trusts facts more than hunches.
blocks.pythagorean.plane.intuitive.balanced: Intuitive plane balanced: good instincts used alongside reason.
blocks.pythagorean.plane.intuitive.strong: Intuitive plane strong: strong hunches and a sense for what is unseen.
blocks.pythagorean.arrow.123.strength: Arrow of planning (1-2-3): a natural organiser who thinks ahead.
blocks.pythagorean.arrow.123.weakness: Missing 1-2-3: planning takes conscious effort; lists and calendars help.
blocks.pythagorean.arrow.456.strength: Arrow of will (4-5-6): strong determination to carry plans through.
blocks.pythagorean.arrow.456.weakness: Missing 4-5-6, the arrow of frustration: setbacks sting; patience and small wins help.
blocks.pythagorean.arrow.789.strength: Arrow of activity (7-8-9): energetic, active and quick to act.
blocks.pythagorean.arrow.789.weakness: Missing 7-8-9: energy needs a push; routines and exercise help.
blocks.pythagorean.arrow.147.strength: Arrow of practicality (1-4-7): good with hands and material matters.
blocks.pythagorean.arrow.147.weakness: Missing 1-4-7: practical tasks need patience and practice.
blocks.pythagorean.arrow.258.strength: Arrow of emotional balance (2-5-8): steady feelings and good inner balance.
blocks.pythagorean.arrow.258.weakness: Missing 2-5-8, the arrow of sensitivity: feelings run deep; self-care helps.
blocks.pythagorean.arrow.369.strength: Arrow of intellect (3-6-9): a good memory and an active mind.
blocks.pythagorean.arrow.369.weakness: Missing 3-6-9: memory and study improve with structure and repetition.
blocks.pythagorean.arrow.159.strength: Arrow of determination (1-5-9): persistence that overcomes obstacles.
blocks.pythagorean.arrow.159.weakness: Missing 1-5-9: decisions can be delayed; clear goals help.
blocks.pythagorean.arrow.357.strength: Arrow of compassion (3-5-7): understanding and spiritual depth.
blocks.pythagorean.arrow.357.weakness: Missing 3-5-7: faith and trust are built slowly through experience.
